title: desmos conchyliatus

The Conch Shell Plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Desmos conchyliatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
